package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

func TestBuildWikiReviewLocalizesValidationErrorsForRussian(t *testing.T) {
	review := buildWikiReview(domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusFailed, &domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview{
		Passed: false,
		RawResult: map[string]any{
			"errors": []any{
				map[string]any{
					"Code":    "REQUIRED_INTERFACE_MISSING",
					"Message": "Required interface is missing or incomplete: User",
				},
				map[string]any{
					"Code":    "NO_SOURCE_FILES",
					"Message": "No source files found",
				},
			},
		},
	}, "ru")

	if review.Passed {
		t.Fatalf("expected failed review")
	}
	if len(review.Errors) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 2 localized errors, got %d", len(review.Errors))
	}

	first, ok := review.Errors[0].(map[string]any)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected first error payload: %#v", review.Errors[0])
	}
	if first["Message"] != "Не найден или некорректен обязательный интерфейс: User" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected localized interface message: %#v", first["Message"])
	}

	second, ok := review.Errors[1].(map[string]any)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected second error payload: %#v", review.Errors[1])
	}
	if second["Message"] != "Исходные файлы не найдены" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected localized source message: %#v", second["Message"])
	}
}

func TestBuildWikiReviewLocalizesOrderingErrorForRussian(t *testing.T) {
	review := buildWikiReview(domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusFailed, &domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview{
		Passed: false,
		RawResult: map[string]any{
			"errors": []any{
				map[string]any{
					"Code":    "TEST_ORDER_INCORRECT",
					"Message": "Incorrect order for question: Arrange",
				},
			},
		},
	}, "ru")

	if len(review.Errors) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one localized error, got %d", len(review.Errors))
	}
	item, ok := review.Errors[0].(map[string]any)
	if !ok || item["Message"] != "Указан неверный порядок элементов: Arrange" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected localized ordering error: %#v", review.Errors[0])
	}
}

func TestBuildWikiReviewLocalizesClassificationErrorForRussian(t *testing.T) {
	review := buildWikiReview(domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusFailed, &domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview{
		Passed: false,
		RawResult: map[string]any{
			"errors": []any{
				map[string]any{
					"Code":    "TEST_CLASSIFICATION_INCORRECT",
					"Message": "Incorrect classification for question: Classify",
				},
			},
		},
	}, "ru")

	if len(review.Errors) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected one localized error, got %d", len(review.Errors))
	}
	item, ok := review.Errors[0].(map[string]any)
	if !ok || item["Message"] != "Элементы распределены по неверным группам: Classify" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected localized classification error: %#v", review.Errors[0])
	}
}

func TestBuildStudentAnswerResponseRedactsAssessmentDiagnostics(t *testing.T) {
	feedback := "correct answer is variant-b"
	rawResult := assessmentDiagnosticRawResult()
	autoReview := &domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview{
		ValidatorName: "ms-go-student",
		Passed:        false,
		Feedback:      &feedback,
		RawResult:     rawResult,
		CheckedAt:     time.Now().UTC(),
	}

	student := buildStudentAnswerResponse(domain.StudentTaskAnswer{ID: "answer-id"}, autoReview, nil)
	if student.AutoReview == nil || student.AutoReview.Feedback != nil {
		t.Fatalf("student assessment feedback was not redacted: %+v", student.AutoReview)
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(student.AutoReview.RawResult)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("marshal student raw result: %v", err)
	}
	assertNoAssessmentAnswerKey(t, encoded)
	if !strings.Contains(string(encoded), "ASSESSMENT_INCORRECT") {
		t.Fatalf("safe generic assessment error is missing: %s", encoded)
	}

	trusted := buildAnswerResponse(domain.StudentTaskAnswer{ID: "answer-id"}, autoReview, nil)
	if trusted.AutoReview == nil || trusted.AutoReview.Feedback == nil || trusted.AutoReview.RawResult["items"] == nil {
		t.Fatalf("trusted diagnostics were unexpectedly modified: %+v", trusted.AutoReview)
	}
	if rawResult["items"] == nil {
		t.Fatal("student projection mutated stored diagnostics")
	}
}

func TestBuildWikiReviewUsesSafeAssessmentProjection(t *testing.T) {
	review := buildWikiReview(domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusFailed, &domain.StudentTaskAnswerAutoReview{
		Passed:    false,
		RawResult: assessmentDiagnosticRawResult(),
	}, "ru")

	if review.Passed || len(review.Errors) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected safe assessment review: %+v", review)
	}
	errorItem, ok := review.Errors[0].(map[string]any)
	if !ok || extractStringField(errorItem, "message", "Message") != "Ответ на задание неверен" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected safe localized error: %#v", review.Errors[0])
	}
	details, ok := review.Details.(map[string]any)
	if !ok || details["source"] != "task_test" || details["mode"] != "single_choice" || details["items"] != nil {
		t.Fatalf("unsafe assessment details: %#v", review.Details)
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(review)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("marshal wiki review: %v", err)
	}
	assertNoAssessmentAnswerKey(t, encoded)
}

func assessmentDiagnosticRawResult() map[string]any {
	return map[string]any{
		"source":            "task_test",
		"mode":              "single_choice",
		"total_questions":   2,
		"correct_answers":   1,
		"incorrect_answers": 1,
		"errors": []any{
			map[string]any{"Code": "TEST_VARIANT_INCORRECT", "Message": "Incorrect answer for question: Two"},
		},
		"items": []any{
			map[string]any{
				"test_id":              "question-one",
				"selected_variant_id":  "variant-a",
				"correct_variant_id":   "variant-a",
				"correct_variant_text": "Answer A",
				"correct":              true,
			},
		},
	}
}

func assertNoAssessmentAnswerKey(t *testing.T, payload []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, forbidden := range []string{
		`"items"`,
		`"correct":`,
		"correct_answers",
		"incorrect_answers",
		"correct_variant_id",
		"correct_variant_text",
		"correct_order",
		"correct_group",
		"expected_group",
		"group_source_key",
		"selected_variant_id",
		"submitted_variant_ids",
		"submitted_group_assignments",
		"TEST_VARIANT_INCORRECT",
		"TEST_ORDER_INCORRECT",
		"TEST_CLASSIFICATION_INCORRECT",
	} {
		if strings.Contains(string(payload), forbidden) {
			t.Fatalf("student payload exposes %q: %s", forbidden, payload)
		}
	}
}
